clips.label: Capped ramp control
clips.details:
Reproduces all twenty paintings from the previous experiment exactly. A broad city opens, but the largest repaint jump remains.

Eight seconds, 24 fps, recurrent Krea Turbo feedback, three Euler intervals, bounded Lanczos motion and RIFE 4.25 scale 1. Each branch consumes its own previous painting. The opening through 2s is shared.

clips.label: Earlier steady noise 0.60
clips.details:
Changes only the noise curve to an earlier 0.60 plateau. It gradually opens a smaller central hole but fails to become the broad city.
